pairs: Paulus servus Dei, Apostolus autem Jesu Christi secundum fidem electorum Dei, et agnitionem veritatis, quæ secundum pietatem est
Paul, a servant of God and an Apostle of Jesus Christ, in accord with the faith of God’s elect and in acknowledgment of the truth which is accompanied by piety,
in spem vitæ æternæ, quam promisit qui non mentitur,
in the hope of the eternal life that God, who does not lie,
promised before the ages of time,
manifestavit autem temporibus suis verbum suum in prædicatione,
which, at the proper time, he has manifested by his Word,
quæ credita est mihi secundum præceptum Salvatoris nostri Dei:
in the preaching that has been entrusted to me by the command of God our Savior;
Tito dilecto filio secundum communem fidem,
beloved son according to the common faith.
from God the Father and from Christ Jesus our Savior.
Hujus rei gratia reliqui te Cretæ,
For this reason, I left you behind in Crete:
so that those things which are lacking,
you would correct, and so that you would ordain, throughout the communities,
priests, (just as I also ordained you)
if such a man is without offense,
Oportet enim episcopum sine crimine esse,
And a bishop, as a steward of God,
non percussorem, non turpis lucri cupidum:
not violent, not desiring tainted profit,
amplectentem eum, qui secundum doctrinam est, fidelem sermonem:
embracing faithful speech which is in agreement with doctrine,
ut potens sit exhortari in doctrina sana, et eos qui contradicunt, arguere.
so that he may be able to exhort in sound doctrine and to argue against those who contradict.
For there are, indeed, many who are disobedient,
who speak empty words, and who deceive,
especially those who are of the circumcision.
teaching things which should not be taught,
for the favor of shameful gain.
a prophet of their own kind,
This testimony is true. Because of this,
Quam ob causam increpa illos dure, ut sani sint in fide,
rebuke them sharply, so that they may be sound in the faith,
not paying attention to Jewish fables,
et mandatis hominum, aversantium se a veritate.
nor to the rules of men who have turned themselves away from the truth.
Omnia munda mundis: coinquinatis autem et infidelibus,
All things are clean to those who are clean. But to those who are defiled,
sed inquinatæ sunt eorum et mens et conscientia.
nothing is clean; for both their mind and their conscience have been polluted.
They claim that they know God. But,
by their own works, they deny him,
et ad omne opus bonum reprobi.
and reprobate, toward every good work.
